Subject: Vendor onboarding question: invoice submission options and PO mapping

Hi Rafael,

Quick question as we complete onboarding for ClearSky — our AP team needs clarity on the preferred invoice submission route and what fields you require on the PDF/subject so our ERP can automate routing. We saw the portal option but we're running a multi-week rollout and would like to start sending invoices by email initially to keep cashflow steady.

Can you confirm:
- Whether you accept invoices by email as a short-term fallback while we complete portal provisioning?
- The minimum required PO fields you need to match (PO number location, line-level vs header-level PO, tax/VAT handling)?
- Any subject token convention to avoid manual triage?

I attached a sample invoice to show our current layout. Appreciate any quick guidance so we can configure our output.

Elena —

Thanks for the sample and the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can accept email invoices as a temporary fallback while the portal account is set up, but there are a few constraints to keep things automatable. Vanessa + Monica are on copy to confirm the exact field mappings and to kick off portal provisioning.

High-level:
- Temporary email fallback: acceptable for the next 4 weeks with agreed subject token (see below). After that, we expect invoices to move to the portal to avoid manual processing.
- PO matching: our AP system prefers a header-level PO number in the invoice body and also supports line-level PO mapping for multi-PO invoices, but there are edge cases (see Vanessa).
- Subject token: please prefix emails with INV-REDWOOD-<vendorid>-YYYYMMDD or put the PO in the subject like "INV-REDWOOD-CS-12345-20280302". That avoids manual subject triage.

Next steps: Vanessa will outline the minimum PDF fields and acceptable filename/subject patterns. Monica will share the portal onboarding form and a short timeline for access.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the sample. A few pragmatic rules that will keep your email fallback automatable and prevent delays:

Required (for email fallback ingestion):
- Filename: include vendor shortid and invoice number, e.g. CS_INV_20280301_000123.pdf
- Subject line: include one of: PO:<number> or INV-REDWOOD-CS-<invoice#>-YYYYMMDD (we prioritize PO:<number> when present)
- Invoice PDF: clear header area with vendor name, invoice number, invoice date, total, and PO number (if present) on the first page.
- Line-items: if you include line-level PO references, include a column called "PO Number" so our OCR can map line items; otherwise we'll default to header PO.
- VAT/Tax: include a single summary row named "Tax" and the tax total amount. We store tax as a single field.

Acceptable exceptions (short-term):
- Multi-PO single PDF: ok if you include a cover page that lists mappings (Invoice 000123 -> PO 11111, PO 22222). Otherwise we may need manual review.
- Multiple invoices in one PDF: not supported for automated ingestion — please send separate PDFs per invoice number.

Automation tips:
- Use subject token: INV-REDWOOD-CS-<invoice#>-YYYYMMDD to ensure instant routing.
- If you expect line-level tax/VAT per line, note that our OCR sometimes misaligns columns for complex tables; prefer a simple columnar layout or provide a CSV via portal.

For the portal: Monica will send the onboarding form — the portal will accept CSV/EDIFACT/Invoice PDF and supports multi-PO line mapping natively. For now, if you use the email fallback please follow the rules above to keep processing times within SLA (3 business days).

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Ops Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Elena —

Short answers:
- Multi-PO with cover page: acceptable for automated routing if the cover page uses the exact string "Invoice mapping" and then lists lines in the format: Invoice <invoice#> -> PO <po#1>, PO <po#2>. That exact phrase helps our parser pick it up.
- Intake address: please send invoices to invoices@invoices.redwood.com in the To field and cc vendor-account@clearskyanalytics.com if you want internal tracking. BCC is discouraged because some mail systems strip or alter BCC headers and it complicates automated acknowledgement.

Portal onboarding link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=onboarding-form-RedwoodVendor-2028 (fill out vendor legal name, remit-to, tax id, and a primary AP contact). Once the form is submitted we can provision portal accounts within 3 business days — we recommend moving to the portal after your initial pilot week.

I created a short mutual action plan:
- Today: Elena to start sending invoices with subject token INV-REDWOOD-CS-<invoice#>-YYYYMMDD and To invoices@invoices.redwood.com.
- Within 48 hrs: vendor to submit onboarding form (link above).
- Within 3 business days after form: Redwood provisions portal access.

If anything blocks the form (tax id or remit-to mismatch), reply to this thread and we’ll escalate.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
